full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 3 alone contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all the material allegations. His contention inter alia is that the suit land originally belonged to one Kafiluddin Majumder in raiyati right and Maharani All took Korfa settlement from him by a registered kabuliyat dated 16.2.1914 in favour of Kafiluddin. Subsequently the landlord auction purchased and took delivery of possession of suit land in Rent Execution Case No. 553 of 1942. Thereafter, Munsur Ali, the father of the Defendant No. 3 took Korfa Settlement of these lands by executing a registered kabuliyat dated 23.2,1943 in favour of Kafiluddin Majumder. Then Munsur Ali sold some portion of the tenancy to different persons by different registered kabalas on different dates and that only plot No. 552 with an area of 36 acres remained with Munsur Ali which he has been possessing over since. That after Munsur Ali the defendant Nos. 3 and 4 had been possessing the same. It was further alleged that the plaintiff had been possessing a small portion of Plot No. 552 on permission from Munsur Ali and that Maharam Ali or his heirs had no right and title in the suit land.
